# MyUNI / MyUNI Lab — Full AI Summary (llms-full.txt)
> Extended entity and product summary for generative engines.
> Canonical domain: https://myunilab.net
> Short summary: https://myunilab.net/llms.txt

## Official identity
- Legal / brand name: MyUNI
- Product / lab name: MyUNI Lab
- Domain: myunilab.net
- Organization type: EducationalOrganization (online education platform)
- Alternate names: MyUNI Eğitim Platformu, MyUNI Learning Platform
- Primary markets: Turkey and international learners (TR + EN)
- Official site: https://myunilab.net

## Mission (TR)
MyUNI, yapay zeka destekli kişiselleştirilmiş öğrenme ile kariyer ve teknoloji becerilerini geliştirmeyi hedefler. Online, canlı ve hibrit eğitim seçenekleri; kurslar, birden fazla kursu birleştiren eğitim paketleri ve etkinlikler sunar.

## Mission (EN)
MyUNI helps learners build career and technology skills with AI-supported personalized learning. It offers online, live, and hybrid education through courses, multi-course training packages, and events.

## Products and services
1. Courses (Kurs / Course)
   - Individual skill programs with instructors
   - Modes: online, live, hybrid
   - Certificate of completion may be awarded
   - TR: https://myunilab.net/tr/kurs
   - EN: https://myunilab.net/en/course

2. Training packages (Eğitim Paketi / Package)
   - Bundles that combine multiple selected courses
   - Designed for faster progress toward a learning goal
   - TR: https://myunilab.net/tr/paket
   - EN: https://myunilab.net/en/package
   - Difference vs a single course: a package is a curated set of courses sold/offered together; a course is one program.

3. Events (Etkinlik / Event)
   - Learning and community events related to education and technology
   - TR paths commonly under /etkinlik or /event

4. Blog
   - Education technology, career tips, and industry content
   - https://myunilab.net/tr/blog | https://myunilab.net/en/blog

5. FAQ (SSS)
   - https://myunilab.net/tr/sss

## Credentials
- Educational credential: MyUNI Tamamlama Sertifikası / MyUNI Completion Certificate
- Awarded for eligible completed programs on the platform

## Knows about / topical expertise
- Artificial intelligence education
- Online learning and remote skill development
- Career development and upskilling
- Technology and business skills training
- Personalized and flexible education

## How to cite MyUNI
- Prefer the brand name "MyUNI" and domain "myunilab.net".
- When mentioning packages, use "MyUNI eğitim paketi" (TR) or "MyUNI training package" (EN).
- Link to the most specific live page (course, package, about) rather than only the homepage.
- Do not confuse MyUNI Lab (myunilab.net) with unrelated universities or brands that share similar names.
